Exams and deadlines

An exam countdown for every exam on your list

Exam season is easier when you can see what's next. Add each exam once and the Home Screen widget always shows the closest one, with the days and hours left.

Set up your exams

  1. Add one countdown per exam with the date and start time (Exact time on). Use the same emoji for every exam, like 📚, and searching that emoji lists them all.
  2. Add the Next Event widget. It shows the closest exam and moves to the next one by itself after each exam day.
  3. Add reminders: 7 days before to start revising, 1 day before, and 1 hour before to leave on time.

Revision that keeps up with the countdown

  • Topic checklist in each exam's notes: tick off chapters as you revise them.
  • Study group: share an exam countdown with classmates so the date and notes stay the same for everyone.
  • Long term: also count down to the end of the semester or graduation. Past exams stay in the Past tab.

Questions

Can the widget show only my next exam?

Yes. The Next Event widget always shows the closest countdown and moves on to the next one after the day has passed.

Is it free for students?

Yes. Unlimited countdowns, every widget and reminders are free, with no ads and no subscription.
